results.title: Berry town hall addresses recent debate absence
results.description: Less than a week after pulling out of a planned District 20 candidate forum, Rep. Alonna Berry, D-Milton, held a town hall meeting Aug. 31 at Milton Public Library, where she explained to more than 100 attendees why she canceled. “My family is navigating a recent and significant health challenge right now,” she said. “We’re learning how to balance appointments, work, two young children and simply being there for the people we love ... I could’ve handled last week better and I apologize.”
